title: 第二十一章 魔踪第二十二章 我是熊二
lines: 雪花纷飞，师徒两人过了一个安静的大年夜。
吃了年夜饭，王贤许了愿。
等到天黑，手里捏着师父从山下买回来的烟花，看着一朵朵绚丽的烟火在昆仑雪山绽放。
这是王贤最开心的一刻。
忘了百花婆婆伤他的那一道阴寒剑气。
也忘了东海的两个女人去了北坡的剑宗，会不会过些日子来找师父的麻烦。
触景生情，老道士笑道：“明年，让你师姐留在道观过年，我多买一些烟花给你们。”
王贤嘿嘿笑道：“师父放心，等到春天，我去剑宗找师叔，一定替你把灵石要回来。”
老道士闻言一时无语。
过了半晌，王贤又燃放了一枝烟花之后。
才淡淡一笑：“等到秋天，为师带你去山上采些灵药，拿到山下市集去卖。”
王贤应道：“师父放心，以后我和师姐挣钱养你！”
老道士哈哈笑道：“好，我就等着那一天。”
大年初三，巳时。
老道士在三清祖师面前念诵道经，王贤站在雪松树下迎风斩雪。
一剑无痕，挥剑斩出，渐渐有了几分飘逸的神韵。
还没等师父一卷道经念完，王贤忍不住一声惊叫：“师父，东海的两个女人又来了！”
神识中的两个女子，肩上多了一件兽皮袄子，离山门处还有数十丈。
王贤便忍不住扭头嚷嚷道：“师父，弟子要不要躲起来？”
被百花谷的老婆婆伤了一剑，王贤多了一分心思。
心道惹不起，我躲起来，总可以吧？
老道士放下手里的道经，笑道：“你不用理会她们，有为师在此。”
说完，跟山门外的两女问道：“两位既然去过剑宗，就不该回转，再来找我的麻烦。”
嘴上一边唠叨，一边挥手打开了护山大阵，放两女翩然入内。
王贤一见师父放人，也懒得再去看两个踏雪而来的女人。
见过百花婆婆的阴毒，他对来访的客人再无兴趣。
剑宗的东方霓裳对他好，那是师叔，不是外人。
一壶清茶的香气，等来了南宫飞烟和南宫芷兰两女。
“道兄，那大坑是怎么回事？”
南宫买烟蛾眉轻皱，指着大殿外雪泥渐融的深坑说：“我上回来时，这还是平整的。”
老道士叹了一口气：“百花谷的那个疯婆娘，来寻神剑无果，不仅伤了我的徒儿，还跟我大打出手......”
跟王贤一样，老道士对百花婆婆，向来就没有什么交情。
“难怪她俩来剑宗时，还是一副意难平的模样。”
南宫芷兰叹了口气，缓缓说道：“她们已经离开了剑宗，应该不会再来找麻烦了。”
“百花婆婆竟然伤了你的小徒儿？”
南宫飞烟脸上浮起一抹惊讶之色：“她没说啊，她一个世外高人，怎么可能对后辈出手？”
“她好意思说吗？”
老道士冷冷回道：“她那一道阴寒之气，依旧在我那徒儿体内，没有完全清除，你要不要再检查一番？”
南宫飞烟摇摇头。
沉吟了一下，说道：“我来此见你，却是因为另一件事。”
“何事？”
老道士一愣：“除了神剑之事，我这破道观，还能有什么能让世人惦记？”
此话一出，连在雪松下练剑的王贤，也竖起了耳朵。
content_en:
Snowflakes were flying, and the master and apprentice spent a peaceful New Year's Eve.
After the New Year's Eve dinner, Wang Xian made a wish.
When it got dark, I held the fireworks that Master bought from the mountain in my hands and watched the gorgeous fireworks blooming in the Kunlun Snow Mountain.
This is Wang Xian's happiest moment.
He forgot about the cold sword energy that Granny Baihua used to hurt him.
I also forgot that the two women from Donghai went to the Sword Sect on the north slope and would come to trouble their master in a few days.
Touched by the scene, the old Taoist priest smiled and said: "Next year, let your senior sister stay at the Taoist temple to celebrate the New Year, and I will buy more fireworks for you."
Wang Xian chuckled and said: "Master, don't worry. When spring comes, I will go to the Sword Sect to find my uncle, and I will definitely get the spirit stone back for you."
The old Taoist priest was speechless for a moment.
After a while, Wang Xian set off another firework.
Then he smiled faintly and said: "When autumn comes, I will take you to the mountains to collect some elixirs and sell them in the market below."
Wang Xian responded: "Master, don't worry, my senior sister and I will make money to support you from now on!"
The old Taoist priest laughed and said: "Okay, I will wait for that day."
...
It's the third day of the Lunar New Year.
The old Taoist priest recited Taoist scriptures in front of the founder of the Sanqing Dynasty. Wang Xian stood under the cedar tree and cut the snow in the wind.
There was no trace of the sword, and the sword was slashed out, gradually gaining a somewhat elegant charm.
Before Master could finish reciting a Taoist scripture, Wang Xian couldn't help but exclaimed: "Master, the two women from Donghai are here again!"
The two women in their consciousness had animal skin jackets on their shoulders, and they were still dozens of feet away from the mountain gate.
Wang Xian couldn't help but turned around and shouted: "Master, do you want me to hide?"
After being wounded by the old woman in Baihua Valley, Wang Xian had more thoughts.
I can't afford to offend my heart, so I can hide, right?
The old Taoist priest put down the Taoist scripture in his hand and said with a smile: "You don't need to pay attention to them, there is a good teacher here."
After saying that, he asked the two women outside the mountain gate: "Since you two have been to Jianzong, you shouldn't turn around and come to trouble me again."
While chattering, he waved his hand to open the mountain guarding formation and let the two women in.
As soon as Wang Xian saw his master letting him go, he didn't bother to look at the two women who came through the snow.
Having seen Granny Baihua's insidiousness, he was no longer interested in visiting guests.
Dongfang Nishang from Jianzong treats him well because he is his uncle, not an outsider.
The aroma of a pot of tea awaited the two girls Nangong Feiyan and Nangong Zhilan.
"Brother Dao, what's going on with that big pit?"
Nangong Mai frowned lightly, pointed to the deep pit outside the hall where the snow and mud was gradually melting, and said, "When I came back last time, this was still flat."
The old Taoist priest sighed: "That crazy woman from Baihua Valley came to look for the divine sword to no avail. Not only did she hurt my disciple, she also fought with me..."
Like Wang Xian, the old Taoist priest had never had any friendship with Granny Baihua.
"No wonder they were still upset when they came to Jianzong."
Nangong Zhilan sighed and said slowly: "They have left Jianzong and should not cause trouble again."
"Grandma Baihua actually hurt your little disciple?"
A look of surprise appeared on Nangong Feiyan's face: "She didn't say anything. How could she, an expert from outside the world, take action against the younger generation?"
"Is she embarrassed to say it?"
The old Taoist priest replied coldly: "Her cold energy is still in my disciple's body and has not been completely eliminated. Do you want to check it again?"
Nangong Feiyan shook his head.
After pondering for a while, he said, "I came here to see you because of another thing."
"What's the matter?"
The old Taoist priest was stunned: "Besides the matter of the divine sword, what else can the world remember about my broken Taoist temple?"
As soon as these words came out, even Wang Xian, who was practicing his sword under the cedar, pricked up his ears.
